integrity: The derivations and tests were undertaken for this finding; the finite checker is not an infinite proof. No independent validation or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent coupon sampling only; exact joint probability was previously enumerated by Myers and Wilf. The all-time likelihood-ratio inequality is not claimed to hold for unequal frequencies. Priority may be affected by a general earlier total-positivity theorem.
title: Likelihood-ratio monotonicity of singleton coupons at collection completion
